title: Minigame: A24.5 SMOKE Strength

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the A24.5 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): a board where SMOKE is placed, with no counters needed.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): SMOKE's strength is asked of its source, chemical, and the PFPh's order of attacks, entered by hand on the Rule Workbench.

introduction: Which side up a SMOKE counter takes, and its Hindrance, by what placed it.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
